content: Pɔl u Malte
Ungö kàwü bi mɔ̈ɔ̈, bi kàyöb naa isaŋ aki ikɔb a kya Malte.
Aŋabul biswɛŋ ukwen a ifà asin: ntɔn mbul kàsɛmà munɔ anà mpye yàkäl mbɔɔn, ba bàyöbà böl a mbaa a kölàköl, waa bàwɛl bi banswà ukɔl a la.
Pɔl kàkàbɔɔl ibiŋ a nkön, waa kàtɔɔm kya u mbaa. Ntɔn un'swey a mbaa, iyäy mwɛy laa kyàyàtoo kya, waa kyundäär u kɔɔ.

Mpal bàmɛn aŋabul ntäy wàmunyɔŋ u kɔɔ ande, ba bàtɛn ba a ba naa: « Ndandaa mbuur wà, wà un'dwää a baar. Nde kan'too anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ u ngyäl a kölàköl, wɛɛ Balàbal kàmupà anki mbwo mukal anà mɔ̈ɔ̈. »
Pɔl waa kàfwaŋ ntäy awun u mbaa ukɔɔn awem akà kisaay.

Baar bàdilà naa nde uyäm, itàkal naa nde ukü kà imbürà. Wɛɛ ungö mudil an'taaŋ mbɔɔn, ba bàmɛn naa akà undiir mwɛy wà un'be kun'yeel anki. Apan ba bàsɔɔm an'kyän, waa bàtɛɛnà naa nde wà nzam.
Tsütsü paa, yàkäl anà ndwaŋ a mfum a isaŋ akin, ikɔb ande Pübiliyüs. Nde kiwɛl anà kipɛ ikal abɔ̈ɔ̈n u ndwà ande ilä itär unsà isam kyanswà.
Wɛɛ yàmɛnà naa taar a Pübiliyüs kàkäl aŋàbɔ̈ɔ̈n, ntɔn nde kàkäl anà limpye anà pfulà a pfulà a an'kil. Pɔl waa kàkun'ler. U mbwo a ngyamàkà anà nsyeel a an'kɔɔ, nde waa kun'kɔɔr.
Ungö apan, aŋan'kyäl bumwɛy banswà bàkäl uboo a isaŋ aki bàyi sye akà nde, waa bàkɔɔrà.
Ba bipɛ làkoo mbɔɔn. Mpal kàbilà bi kà an'swà, ba bipɛ indiir aŋàkwo ntɔn mbwo abi.
Pɔl kan'kɔlà Lɔmà
Ungö a ngɔɔn tär, bi kàbilà kà an'swà a Alɛksandri màkyer isà uboo a isaŋ, u mbil a ma bàsi isii a Dyɔskür.
Bi kàtoo u Siraküse, waa kàkäl paa ilä itär.
Fà apan, bi kàyilabà un'kɔɔl a an'dà tii kàkàtol bi Rɛgyɔ. Taaŋtyà, un'pöb a mper angyɛl laa kàyi wa, ungö a ilä byeel bi kàtöl Pusɔlɛs.
Akun, bi kàbwey anà atɔŋ, bà bilɔ̈ɔ̈m mukal ilä nsambwaar apà ba. Le, bi Lɔmà kàkyen abà.
Mpal bàwem atɔŋ a Lɔmà làsaŋ a ngyeel abi, ba bàyiwool u Yà a Apiyüs anà u Trwa Tavɛrn. Mpal kàmɛn nde ba, Pɔl kàkömà Nzam, waa kàfàwal ngwal.
Mpal kàtöl bi Lɔmà, ba bàpɛ Pɔl mbwo mukal anà ndwà ande aŋàyen anà ŋità mwɛy mukun'kyɛŋ.
Pɔl u Lɔmà

Yàmɛnà naa ungö a ilä itär, Pɔl kàbel abyääl a Ayudà. Mpal bàköŋ ba banswà, nde kàtɛn a ba naa: « Atɔŋ abaal, mɛ mbuur mpa kàkyer akà undiir mwɛy wà ube akà un'sɛŋ abi, itàkal akà ikin byàfü akà andweer abi, mɛ ban'kör u Yɛlusàlɛm anà ban'pɛ kà an'kɔɔ a Alɔmà.
Baar abà, ungö akan'fuul un'lɔɔn, bàkyer alan'wɛy ntɔn ba bàmɛn anki akà ube mwɛy ban'kwo mukan'twääl ukwà.
Wɛɛ Ayudà bàkyer atɔn, lalan kàlɔ̈m mɛ musà un'lɔɔn kusà a Sɛzar, ukɔɔn akal anà an'kyän mufüün un'sɛŋ amɛ.
Lalà in'lɔ̈m mɛ mubwey anà muyääm anà bɛ. Kutɛn aŋàbwaŋ, yà ntɔn làkyän a Isàlɛl waa mɛ in'wà aŋàlal un'siŋ wà. »
Ba bun'fuur naa: « Bi, bi kàwɛl anki akà un'kaan mwɛy awà kàfü Yuday ntɔn ngye, akà un'tɔŋ mwɛy kàfü anki kwo wa kàyikyään ndaa itàkal mutɛn ube angye akà bi.
Wɛɛ bi imanà naa yubwaŋ bi iwem u mun angye ŋakwo ndaa akayweerà ngye, ntɔn bi ikyàyöb naa mper yanswà ikööŋ awà ngye ki bàkyer ayitɔn kya. »

Ba bàpɛɛl ilä mwɛy mubwey anà nde, ba bàyi baar mbɔɔn muyun'man u ndwà ande. Unsà an'yääm ande, nde kàkäl mutà imbäl a Imwol a Nzam. Fà tutu tii sisye, nde kàleŋà naa ba bàkyey ndaa kàtɛɛnà nde ntɔn Yɛsu, sɛmà un'kɔɔn a Mɔsɛ anà Aŋangɔɔm.
Baar amwɛy bàkyey ndaa kàtɛɛnà nde, wɛɛ bumwɛy bàkyer atɔn musà làkwikilà.
Apan ba bàkaabà unsà isak isak. Abun, Pɔl kàkwɛy ndaa mwɛy mpɛl: « Dweelà In'kyɛɛl kàkäl anà iböŋ kàkyään nde andweer abɛ u mbwo a ŋangɔɔm Yɛsay
naa:

content.text: Bɛ làkyer asàwem ubwaŋàbwaŋ, wɛɛ bɛ làsàyöb anki.
Bɛ làsàler ubwaŋàbwaŋ, wɛɛ bɛ làsàman anki.
Ntɔn mpem a un'sɛŋ kàkyàbwà bwoor,
anà ba bàkɔɔn abulà mper in'wà mɛ ntɔn mɛ in'kɔ̈ɔ̈n akɔɔr ba."

content: Abwɛy, làyöb naa ngweel a mɔ̈ɔ̈ a Nzam ayi bàtöm akà baar mpa abà Ayudà: ba, ba bàkyer asàwem! »
Ungö bàwem ba ndaa ayi yanswà, Ayudà waa bàkyen, bàmuyisyeel mbaaŋ a ngwal ba a ba.
Abun, Pɔl kàkyer yanswà mbul yweel u ndwà kàfafurà nde. Nde kàfawalà baar banswà bàyee mukun'ler.
Nde kàkyäänà ndaa a Imwol a Nzam anà kàlɔɔŋà indiir iler Mwol Yɛsu Klistɔ, unsà uyɔl banswà anà u duu.
